minValues.description:
Minimum number of non-missing values in window for the final computed result for the window to have a value.
Otherwise, the final result for the window is null or NaN.  "Non-missing value" here refers to an
individual element field, not the entire element.

If this field is not specified when {@link #window} is a {@link Period}, this field is treated as having value 1.
If this field is not specified when {@link #window} is an integer, this parameter is treated as if it were the
size of the window.
If this field is not specified when {@link #window} is an {@link WindowSpec}, this parameter is treated as if it
were the span of the window.

Value should be between 0 and Window Size if {@link #window} is an Integer, or Window Span if {@link #window} is
a {@link WindowSpec}

window.description:
Size of the moving window.

If this is an integer, this is the number of values used for calculating the statistic. Each window has a fixed
size.

If this is a {@link Period}, it will be treated as a time period for windowing (e.g. an "offset" in Pandas).
A {@link Period} is only valid for datetime-like indexes and will cause an error if {@link #spec} for Timeseries
conversion is not specified.

spec.description:
Spec to specify the column/expr to be used to create the rolling window, rather than the {@link Collection}’s
integer index. Timeseries will be constructed based on this, before running any rolling window aggregations.
A `null` spec assumes that there is no Timeseries nature to collection.

_src.description: The collection on which we want to apply the window.

name: RollingBase
